results.title: The Lambwolf
results.overview: The leaders of a town meet to face an imminent problem, but an unexpected twist calls into question everything they thought they knew...

results.title: 3 Wishes for Christmas
results.overview: While spending Christmas with her best friend’s family, Tessa falls for her friend’s brother and faces potential heartache when his ex arrives.

results.title: Painkiller
results.overview: An ex-championship boxer turned sports gambling addict finds himself in the crosshairs of a vicious gang.

results.title: Midori plays Mendelssohn Kronberg Festival 2025
results.overview: Violinist Midori performs Felix Mendelssohn's Violin Concerto No. 2 in E minor alongside the Frankfurt Radio Symphony Orchestra and conductor Michael Sanderling. The 2025 Kronberg Festival concludes with this concert in the intimate setting of the Forum Casals.

results.title: Natasha
results.overview: After surviving a violent assault by a serving soldier who was convicted but walked free with a suspended sentence, Natasha O'Brien refused to stay silent.

results.title: Let It Rain
results.overview: A grumpy widower's life changes when he finds himself at the center of an event that could bring rain to his drought-stricken village, altering his relationship with his daughter and the community.

results.title: Amor Verdadeiro
results.overview: Paulo and Judite, a gay man and a lesbian, live together. One night, watching a romantic movie, they complain over feeling lonely, but at least they have one another. Paulo states that Judite is the love of his life. Judite answers that Paulo would be the love of her life, if he were a woman. This conversation sparks up an idea in Judite’s mind, and she starts introducing estrogen – a feminizing hormone – in Paulo’s food.

results.title: Joelma: Isso é Calypso Tour Brasil - Ao Vivo em Vitória
results.original_title: Joelma: Isso é Calypso Tour Brasil - Ao Vivo em Vitória
results.overview: The DVD Isso É Calypso Tour Brasil: Ao Vivo em Vitória features Joelma reviving a vibrant energy with her greatest hits live, recorded at Praça do Papa in January 11, 2025 and released in December 24, 2025.

results.title: Ben's Sister
results.overview: In 2015 during the last weekend before graduation in Mill Valley, California, Ben and his friends are hell-bent on winning the Senior Scavenger Hunt, which involves completing outrageous, sexual, and illegal tasks—all filmed and posted on Facebook. In their quest to win, Ben goes a bit overboard with his ex, and his friend’s end up roping in Emma, his freshman sister. Wanting to be cool and one of the guys, Emma gets sucked into their plan to rack up points without realizing it. Ben suddenly feels compelled to protect her, which sparks a dilemma: confront his friends at the Post-Scav Hunt party or play it cool and enjoy his final moments of high school with his bros.

results.title: Tapped
results.overview: After a brutal attack on his girlfriend, an autistic young man battles trauma, isolation, and a broken system in South London.

results.title: Susan
results.overview: Susan Suchan, a Tulsa advocate living with frontotemporal dementia, confronts changes in her health and independence while making unconventional plans for the end of her life. Filmed over several years, the documentary follows Susan and her family as they navigate care, choice and mortality.

results.title: Bad Girl Sunday School
results.overview: Two bad girls at a private academy for wayward girls receive help from a mysterious inspirational teacher who helps reform them.

results.title: The Promise
results.overview: Former bartender George Batra awaits his lost love's return after 20 years, hoping to reunite at the bar where they met and parted. As he waits for their fated reunion, he uncovers what he left behind.

results.title: Leonardo
results.overview: Inspired by Vitruvian Man and Leonardo DiCaprio syndrome, "Leonardo" imagines a near future where Néstor, after losing his partner, seeks comfort in an artificial replica of her. What begins as a desperate attempt to revive their relationship seems to work... until an unexpected event turns everything upside down.

results.title: 1 jour
results.overview: As Raphaël calls Zoé, who has left to work in London, he remembers a day in August in Paris. From the bedroom to the Bois de Vincennes, passing through the streets he knew with her, the apparent purity of his memories crumbles.

results.title: Freelm
results.overview: The film was created in relation to a musical improvisation project in which Antonello Salis, Sandro Satta, Mark Dresser, and Massimo Carrano participated. The work is based on abstract animations made with various techniques directly on 35mm cinema film that are interspersed with live action sections that creatively document the stages of the jam session.

results.title: Thiago Ventura - O Pequeno Big Big
results.original_title: Thiago Ventura - O Pequeno Big Big
results.overview: The fifth stand-up special by comedian Thiago Ventura.

results.title: Untold
results.overview: Vivian Vera is a multi-awarded journalist with a dark past. She sensationalized some of her breaking news for her ambition. Her distortion of the truth ruined lives, and these lives have begun to haunt Vivian – they want her to join them... or else they will kill everyone around her who helped her in the lie.
